_This page is generated from src/cli.ts and src/usage.ts, so it says what the tool does._

`skill-evals --help`, `skill-evals help`, `skill-evals help <command>` and `skill-evals <command> --help` print the help text on standard output and exit 0; `--help` wins over every other flag. A wrong command line prints the same commands and flags on standard error and exits 2.

## Commands

| Command    | What it does                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| ---------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `run`      | Run every case against subject A and subject B, score both, and print a comparison.                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `score`    | Run every case against one subject and print its scores.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `plan`     | Print what run or score would make: the matrix of harnesses, cases, subjects and reps, the number of runs, and the cases that are not applicable. With --resume or --out naming an earlier command's directory, also an estimate of cost and duration. It starts no harness and writes nothing. |
| `check`    | Run one small prompt in each installed harness and show what its adapter reports.                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `validate` | Check a suite without running it: report every case that does not load and every skill name the subject lacks. Spends nothing.                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `list`     | Show the harnesses in default-preference order, and the cases.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |

## Flags

| Flag                           | Commands                                   | Default                                      | Meaning                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| ------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------ | -------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `--a <subject>`                | `run`, `plan`                              | main                                         | The baseline.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `--b <subject>`                | `run`, `plan`                              | the project, uncommitted changes included    | The change.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `--subject <subject>`          | `score`, `plan`, `check`, `validate`       | the project, uncommitted changes included    | The subject to score, to probe, or to check the skill names of.                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `--harness <ids\|all>`         | `run`, `score`, `plan`, `check`            | the first installed one; all for check       | Comma-separated harness ids.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `--case <globs>`               | `run`, `score`, `plan`, `validate`, `list` | every case                                   | Which case ids to run. A glob: * stays within one directory, ** crosses directories, ? is one character, {a,b} is either. Repeat the flag or separate globs with commas.                                                                                                                   |
| `--not-case <globs>`           | `run`, `score`, `plan`, `validate`, `list` | none                                         | Case ids to leave out, as globs like those of --case.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `--tag <tags>`                 | `run`, `score`, `plan`, `validate`, `list` | no tag filter                                | Run the cases that have any of these tags. Repeat the flag or separate tags with commas.                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `--tag-all <tags>`             | `run`, `score`, `plan`, `validate`, `list` | no tag filter                                | Run the cases that have all of these tags.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `--not-tag <tags>`             | `run`, `score`, `plan`, `validate`, `list` | none                                         | Leave out the cases that have any of these tags.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `--heldout`                    | `run`, `score`, `plan`, `validate`, `list` | off                                          | Also run the held-out variants, the ones a case marks with heldout: true. Without it they are left out.                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `--targets`                    | `list`                                     | off                                          | Print the coverage table: for each target skill, how many selected cases name it.                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `--cases <dir>`                | `run`, `score`, `plan`, `validate`, `list` | evals/cases in the project                   | The directory that holds the cases.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `--reps <n>`                   | `run`, `score`, `plan`                     | 3                                            | Runs for each subject and case.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `--jobs <n>`                   | `run`, `score`, `plan`                     | 1                                            | How many runs may be in flight at once. A positive integer. Each run has its own home, workspace and copy of the subject. results.json lists the records in plan order whatever order the runs end in; results.jsonl and the progress lines follow the order they end in.                  |
| `--model <id>`                 | `run`, `score`, `plan`, `check`            | the harness's own default                    | Passed to the harness unchanged.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `--min-score <0..1>`           | `run`, `score`, `plan`                     | no bar                                       | The lowest suite score that passes. The command exits 1 when the suite score of the subject (B for run) is lower.                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `--judge-harness <id>`         | `run`, `score`, `plan`                     | the harness under test                       | The harness that scores judged checks.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `--judge-model <id>`           | `run`, `score`, `plan`                     | the value of --model                         | The model that scores judged checks.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `--judge-api <kind>`           | `run`, `score`, `plan`                     | a harness session                            | Ask the judge model over this API and start no harness process for it. Only anthropic. --judge-harness is then ignored.                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `--judge-url <url>`            | `run`, `score`, `plan`                     | the provider's own                           | The base URL of the judge API.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `--decision-model <id>`        | `run`, `score`, `plan`                     | none                                         | The decision model that scores decision checks.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `--decision-url <url>`         | `run`, `score`, `plan`                     | the provider's own                           | The base URL of the decision model's API.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `--decision-timeout <seconds>` | `run`, `score`, `plan`                     | 60                                           | How long one request to the decision model may take. A positive integer.                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `--lenient`                    | `run`, `score`, `plan`, `validate`, `list` | off: an unknown key is an error              | Drop a key that a case file does not take, and warn, instead of failing. Keys that start with x- are always kept.                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `--isolated`                   | `run`, `score`, `plan`                     | off: the harness loads what its settings say | Start the harness with nothing loaded but the subject, and mark a run invalid when the harness reports anything else as loaded. Only harnesses that declare the isolated capability take it.                                                                                               |
| `--out <dir>`                  | `run`, `score`, `plan`, `check`            | a new temp directory                         | Where results go. A fresh run starts an empty results.jsonl there.                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `--resume <dir>`               | `run`, `score`, `plan`                     | none: a fresh run                            | Continue the earlier command whose output directory this is. It implies --out and must name the same directory as --out when both are given. A run whose key matches a valid record in results.jsonl is not repeated; every other run is made and added. It also turns the judge cache on. |
| `--dry-run`                    | `run`, `score`                             | off                                          | Print what the command would run, as plan does, and exit 0. It starts no harness and writes nothing.                                                                                                                                                                                       |

A subject is what a run loads: a directory, a git ref of the project, or `none`. [Subjects](../concepts/subjects.md) has the details. [Set a pass bar](../guides/pass-bars.md) explains `--min-score` and the exit codes, and [Decision checks](../guides/decision-checks.md) explains the decision model's flags.
